tips: Q her on cd dodge her charm or pool it if needed, when her charm is down you don't have to hide behind minions so just stay out of the wave to make her choose between using Q on you or the wave.

Easy laning phase, just don't miss any cs and Q him whenever you can. But keep in mind that later into the game, he becomes really annoying for you since he builds Liandry, Rylai, and Morello. Morello might be a bad item, but he can perma apply it on you, so it's pretty useful.
Just Q him, don't tank his enitre E and space out of the wave when he uses his Q.

Wait to see what ability he starts lvl 1 and poke him with Q's, just E > W when he jumps on to pool his E, pretty easy matchup if you play patient, cdr early makes it even easier. He might also buy magic resist early.

LvL 1 Just walk up and don't let her hit the wave. Slowpush the wave into her if she comes close Q her, and don't miss any cs. When the wave crashes, poke her while she's trying to farm. Play safe while the wave is bouncing to you, though, because she will get lvl up before you and might jump and kill you.
Just farm and Q him when he walks up, LvL 2 upgrade your W so you can pool his passive proc. If your pool is on cd, play safe until you get it back.

Dodge his Q's, pool his gold card if needed, and once he hits lvl 6, warn your team. Always shove the wave under his turret so he loses minions when he roams. If you have tp yourself and the fight looks promising, feel free to tp there (but the wave must be in a good spot, which means under tf's tower or slowpushing into you).
Free farming lane, try to not get hit by his Q so he doesn't get stacks off of you. You have more impact than him in team fights.
Dodge her Q's, there is a half-second-long animation before she throws it, so it's not that hard to dodge. Play around her fear (the bar beneath her health).
Try to dodge his Q's, don't let him auto-attack you since it gives him mana, you can outsustain his damage, just farm.

Auto his passive if you can, try to sidestep his Q's, pool the tornado if he has ult, and let your E go off earlier when his windwall is up. The mind game is a lot easier for you since he can't react to your E and needs to predict it, which is very unlikely to happen.
Just farm, no point trying to kill him, especially after lvl 6.

Q her every time she's in range, if she doesn't have tp, you might even try to set up a kill, don't take extended trades, just short ones. You can't react to her ult with pool, it just hits you in it unless she is ulting you from max range, so you need to predict it.

Respect his early damage, don't let him proc his passive since you can't outtrade him if he gets his shield, and keep the wave close to your tower. Pool his R after he fires the bullets, so it goes on cooldown.

Trade Q for Q and pool her stun if needed. Keep in mind she needs to hit you with her Q stun for the stacks to reset, which means that when you pool her Q, she still has 4 stacks and can try to stun you again.

Skilled matchup but harder on your end. You can buy boots early, so it's easier to dodge her Q's. Sometimes the right thing to do is to just walk into her like a psycho to dodge a Q since she wouldn't expect it (Elite talked about this) or pool her Q if needed. Pool her ult, or if you are really experienced, you can dodge it by clicking behind yourself so you're not looking at her while she's ulting.
Try to not get perma hit by his Q's, pool them/his silence if needed. Boots and cdr help you early.

Try to dodge her Q on the concave side, you don't win trades against her shield. When she dashes on you, Q > W fast since pool cancels the Q animation and it looks like you Q her in pool, play safe until you have your W back up.
Just perma trade with him and don't let him hit the wave lvl 1, pool his passive proc if needed, and respect his E when your pool is on cd.

Slowpush into him just like you do into every melee/assassin, and be careful on the bounce. Since Riot fixed Vlad's Q bug, your Q now goes through his E, but it doesn't do damage to him, it only heals you, which is still really nice. Don't get hit by his E or pool it if you have to, you can pool his R even after it has already hit.
Play around his spells, his Q does insane amounts of damage if it hits you with all the ticks, pool his W and try to keep the wave close to your turret.

Trade Q for Q, buying cdr early makes the matchup a lot easier, outspace him and don't let him auto-attack you with his passive proc, try to stay out of his barrel range or pool if you have to, you can try to auto-attack his barrels as soon as they are on 1 hit, but don't get too cocky.
Try to bait his E and kite back or pool if needed, respect his combo, especially if he has ignite.
He will automatically push the wave with his turrets and poke you under the tower, try to dodge his spells and pool his E if you need to, keep farming you outscale.

Hide behind minions while not standing too close to them so you don't get hit by his QQ, stay out of the wave when he uses QE, pool his EQ (fear) if you have to, im pretty sure if his EW starts approaching you, it'll hit you even in pool, so if you think you can't get out of it on time, pool in advance, his R is also really easy to pool. Once he gets his first item, he'll just oneshot the wave with QE and do something on the map (if he's good).
Sidestep her E or pool it if you need to, and play safe until you have it again. Try to keep the wave close to your tower so she doesn't run you down and pool her ult.
Q him when he is in range, and expect him to jump on you with a hammer. Q, once he does that, you have to E > W him and step back, wait for your cooldowns, and sustain.
Try to bait his Q's, he doesn't have that much mana before first back, boots early help you to dodge his Q's more consistently, you can pool his ult in case you didn't know.

Slowpush and perma-auto-Q him, play aggressively, and outspace him, though be careful, enemy jg (maybe even support) might come early and stop you from playing aggressive, so always look on the map. Once he hits lvl 6, be more careful.
Block his Q's, respect his stun, and play safe when your pool is down. When his spells are on cd, you are allowed to play more aggressively. It might be a bit scary if he has ignite.

Don't stand in the wave and go for a Q on her when hers is on cd. You can pool her ult when you see the animation and hear the sound, but it doesn't go on cd, so she can ult you again afterwords if you are still in range.
Her E is hard to dodge if she's good, just spam Q on the wave and dodge/pool her Q, once she hits lvl 6, she'll just ult the wave since it has no cd.
Try to dodge her Q's especially Q2 since it does tons of damage and heals her, trade with her when her Q is down, you can oneshot her wolves with Q, pool her W and play safe untill you have it back.
LvL 2 unlock your pool to counter his W, Respect him, especially if he has ignite, try to sidestep his Q's and keep pooling his W.

He might start E and jump on you lvl 1 with Hail of Blades, so keep that in mind. You can't really poke him since he just outsustains your damage, especially if he has Doran's shield, dodge/pool his Q, and farm. You outscale him hard. Also warn your team because he will most likely roam a lot.
Another generic melee/assassin matchup, slowpush and poke her when she tries to go for a minion, be careful on the bounce. Play around your pool.
She can't really do much to you midlane, just farm block her Q and pool her E if you have to, she will roam, so let your team know.
Stay behind minions so he doesn't hit you with his harpoon or pool it/his Q if needed. Respect his damage and play around his Overheat.
Poke him with Q, outspace him, stay out of his E range, or pool it if you have to, if he buys Bork and mr it becomes a bit hard to deal with him.
You can trade Q for Q but sustain from minions before doing it again because his Q outdamages your heal, dodge his E, or pool it if needed.

Outspace him, try to pool his W, if done correctly, he won't do any damage to you and won't receive any health (hard to do consistently, needs experience).  You can also pool his R when he tries to steal yours, but it doesn't go on cd, so there's no reason to do it unless it's a really specific situation.
Dodge or pool her E if needed, don't get perma hit by her Q's and after lvl 6, if there is a fight happening, try to fight her just so she doesn't ult to help her team.

LvL 1 Just poke him if he walks up, you outsustain his damage, if he has ignite, you should respect him more, but it is still a pretty easy matchup. LvL 6, you can even kill him if you are going early game runes. Also, you can swap to red trinket to clear his mushrooms.

Q her and don't take extended trades, hit the wave as much as you can so she doesn't crash a gigantic minion wave under your turret. You can also pool her E when she throws it, but if you already got hit by it, it'll do damage even in pool.

His Q's are undodgeable, it all just depends on how good/bad the Vel'Koz is. You need to play around the minions so they black his Q's, try not to get hit by his E or pool if needed, if he has R and your pool is down, stay out of his range or you will die.

Let him use his Q1 on you and walk back, that way, you take no damage since you don't get hit by Q2, and he wastes mana. His E is not a real skill shot, so a good Viktor player won't miss it. Respect him if he has ignite. Also, his ult disrupts your E charge.

Yone can be harder than Yasuo but still okay, poke him with auto attacks and Q's early, stay away from him when he has his E+Q3. Try to dodge it or pool if you have to. You need to be careful when you use pool, which goes for every matchup, but it is still worth mentioning since this guy is literally playing Urf.

Don't let him touch the wave lvl1, slowpush into him just like you do in every melee/assassin matchup, don't get hit by double shuriken, pool if you have to. If you pool his R, as soon as he uses it, his mark disappears. If the mark is already on you, you will take damage even in pool.
Don't stay in the wave, that's the only way for him to consistently hit Q's on you. Other than that, just farm can't really poke him unless he makes a mistake.

Try to stay away from his soldiers while also being close enough to Q, a minion, and walk back, if he spams Q early, he will run out of mana. You can be more aggressive when his E is down. Pool his ult, it takes some practice but is not the hardest.
She becomes really scary once she buys some cdr. Try to block her Q's. You can go Second Wind and buy early cdr.

Trade with her lvl 1, once she hits lvl 2, wait for her to hit you with q and pool her w, stay behind minions so she can't hit you with her E, and after lvl 6, don't get hit by double chain. You can also use her passive clone to heal yourself up.

Hard push lvl 1 since Malzahar has a really hard time farming under turret and can't match your push early, look for the enemy jg/supp so you don't get ganeked, once he buys Lost Chapter, he has wave control and can become very annoying, when he gets lvl 6, try to stay healthy so he doesn't kill you with his R, keep looking for enemy jg/supp. He is really problematic for you later on since he just like Aurelion builds Liandry, Rylai, and Morello.

Don't get hit by all of her Q ticks, dodge/pool her E and play safe until you have it back up. If she's missing, when a new wave arrives, count the minions (6 minions on an avarage wave and 7 on a cannon wave).  You have to pool as soon as she presses her R since they buffed it, and now it knocks you up.

He slightly outranges you and can be very annoying, but as long as you don't eat every spell he throws at you, you will sustain back up. It's hard for you to deal with him later on since he has so much health and Seraph's shield, but you still have more impact in team fights.
Go phase rush so he doesn't run you down with his W and rng crits, just Q him whenever you can and farm, no point in fighting him since he has so much sustain + R when he hits lvl 6.
Don't let him stack his passive on you with auto-attacks and play passive. Buying cdr boots early makes the matchup more playable. Pool his ult and keep farming.

Stand behind minions so you don't get hit by her Q's, like already mentioned in the Hwei matchup. If you get hit by her sleep, it'll stun you even in pool, so just pool the projectile, you can play more aggressively when her sleep is on cd.
Easier midlane compared to top, but still hard. Buy cdr early, block his W, and try to stay out of his Q range. If he buys mr you can't do anything, just scale.
